files.test_solution.py:
import unittest
from solution import clone_plan


TEXT = '''
[submodule "live"]
    path = vendor/live
    url = https://example.invalid/live.git
[submodule "ghost"]
    path = vendor/removed
    url = https://example.invalid/removed.git
[submodule "duplicate"]
    path = vendor/live
    url = https://example.invalid/other.git
'''


class TestClonePlan(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_skips_ghost_and_duplicate(self):
        self.assertEqual(clone_plan(TEXT, {'vendor/live/file.txt'}), [
            {'name': 'live', 'path': 'vendor/live', 'url': 'https://example.invalid/live.git'}
        ])

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(clone_plan('', set()), [])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
